title: Cover listener-side mailbox saturation returning remote health429 in monitor tests
outcome: Cover listener-side mailbox saturation returning remote health429 in monitor tests
acceptance: A loopback regression admits mailbox work at the peer listener until its shared budget is full, then drives health through federation_authenticate and HTTP429 mapping into the production monitor.
The healthy link and exact incarnation survive that remote congestion without falsely stamping health success.
Keep local429 regressions and distinguish startup fixture failure from reaching the remote-pressure assertion.
